name: Proton Drive
author: loneycoffee
description: A cloud on the bar that mounts your Proton Drive as a folder with rclone (a systemd user unit with a full VFS cache): a switch to mount it, the space used, mount at login, and quick ways into the folder, the web app and rclone's log. Right click opens the folder. Toggle the panel with: omarchy-shell shell toggle proton-drive

barWidget.description: Mount Proton Drive as a folder
